title: POLYCHARTQA: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models with Multilingual Chart Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the question-answering accuracy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on charts across 10 different languages to measure the performance gap between English and non-English (particularly low-resource) languages, and conducting error analysis to categorize failures specifically stemming from non-English inputs.
